newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Alsons increases stake in cement unit.
newsitem.headline: Alsons increases stake in cement unit.

text.p: Philippine holding firm Alsons Consolidated Resources Inc said on Wednesday its board of directors authorised the purchase of 58 million shares of its subsidiary, Alsons Cement Corp, at the stock market.
In an advisory, the company said the board approved the purchase of shares of its cement unit for 4.80 pesos each.
The additional shares will increase the stake of Alsons Consolidated in the cement firm to 59.61 percent. It did not say how much its holdings were prior to the purchase of the additional shares.
Company officials were not immediately available to give details.
Alsons Consolidated said the funds used to buy the shares were sourced from borrowings.
Alsons Consolidated shares closed on Wednesday six centavos lower at 1.24 peso while Alsons Cement shares rose by 25 centavos to 4.25 pesos.
